module.purpose: Provides the pan-and-zoom controller for a diagram pane, configuring d3-zoom, translating viewport state, and exposing interaction controls to the surrounding system.
module.summary: This module adapts d3-zoom to the application's viewport model. It initializes bounded zoom and translation behavior, caches pane dimensions through ResizeObserver, installs dynamically configurable wheel, drag, pinch, and double-click handlers, and exposes asynchronous viewport and scale operations. It also synchronizes externally controlled viewport state and reports pan/zoom lifecycle events through supplied callbacks.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive diagram navigation and viewport manipulation. Failure would prevent users from panning, zooming, selecting, or synchronizing the rendered canvas.
